summary: Iteration 33 QA — Unified pricing (7 fees), Stripe status catalog, Negozio FSL configurable shop with delivery voucher/file/payment, receipt page, voucher lookup/redeem, stock, delivery-file download. Backend pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration33.py: 12/12 PASSED (TestPricesSync 1/1, TestPublicProductsPrices 2/2, TestStripeCatalog 3/3, TestShopCRUD 1/1, TestPublicShop 3/3, TestCheckoutFlow 1/1, TestDeliveryFile 1/1). Highlights: (a) GET /api/tournaments/{tid} settings.fees photo_price=0.49; PATCH photo_price=0.79 → all photo paid_media items reflect 0.79 immediately; checkout on a photo item returns Stripe test URL and purchase amount syncs; restore to 0.49 works. (b) POST /api/public/tournaments/{slug}/products {kind:album, ref_id:PLAYER} price=2.49; after PATCH digital_price=2.99 idempotent (same id) returns 2.99; restore ok. (c) card-preview 'prices' contains all 7 keys video/photo/team_card/album/player_card/player_card_special/push_pass. (d) GET /stripe/catalog as segreteria → 403; as qa.superadmin → 200 mode='test', account_id present, 7 items each with kind/label/setting/price, tax_code txcd_10302000. POST /stripe/catalog/sync removed (404/405). (e) Shop CRUD: club-manager POST → 403; delivery=file without media_id → 400; empty placements → 400; create voucher product 4.99 with 2 placements+stock 5 → 201, price 4.99, available true, left 5; PATCH price 5.49 + active false → reflected; list includes placements/delivery metadata; DELETE unsold → {archived:false} and gone. (f) Public shop tournament_home returns only active custom placement products, inactive excluded; club placement respects club_ids (empty=all, or specific list); fan-area for logged fan returns tournament_name. (g) Voucher flow: checkout → _mark_paid → voucher_code FSL-XXXX-XXXX; status→open_url '/acquisto/{token}'; receipt has delivery=voucher, receipt_no, amount; voucher lookup lowercase→200; redeem 200 then 409; unknown code 404; stock exhausted second checkout→409 'esaurito'; DELETE sold product→{archived:true} active=false. (h) delivery=file: chunked upload init/put/complete media, product created, paid, receipt.download_url = /api/payments/download/{token} which returns 200 file bytes. Frontend Playwright (chromium 1440x900): STAFF (segreteria) /admin/t/{TID}/negozio shows shop-admin, money-hub-tabs, shop-new opens shop-product-dialog with all fields, delivery voucher toggles voucher-note field, placements toggle, save creates card, shop-toggle suspends with 'NON IN VENDITA' text, shop-edit repopulates dialog, shop-delete removes; shop-voucher-box + voucher-code-input+voucher-lookup work. /admin/t/{TID}/impostazioni settings-prices renders 6 inputs with correct defaults (video 0.99, photo 0.49, digital 2.49, card 3.99, card-special 4.99, push 3.99). SUPER ADMIN /admin/t/{TID}/vendite stripe-catalog shows mode 'TEST / sandbox · acct_1UG08JLbananVr50', stripe-account-status, stripe-catalog-items with stripe-item rows (14 elements due to nested testids for both container+row per kind — 7 kinds present), stripe-prices-settings-link present. PUBLIC /tornei/{slug} shop-strip-tournament_home renders after frontend restart with active tournament_home products (2 shop-buy buttons visible); /tornei/{slug}/giocatori/{PID} player-products contains shop-strip-player, album-offer shows current 2,49 €; fan /account fan-shop present. RECEIPT /acquisto/{token} receipt-page with receipt-title, receipt-voucher-code 'FSL-WN86-TUUF' shown, importo 3,50 €.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/shop.py delete_product: uses `__import__('bson').ObjectId(...)` inline — repository already provides a delete helper via col.delete_one; not a bug but stylistically prefer repo.delete(id) for consistency and to keep _id encoding logic in one place.

routers/shop.py _validate: rejects empty placements but if placements contains only unknown values plus one valid, it still allows the unknown ones silently (bad list). Consider `if bad or not placements: raise bad_request(...)` currently rejects only when bad is non-empty OR placements empty — that IS enforced. OK.

routers/club_extras.py checkout: silently overwrites price_cents on paid_media at checkout time if fees changed — this is the 'sync at buy' guard, good; however this bypasses the sync_items batch and can cause a moment of divergence between admin list and checkout price. Frontend admin list should refetch after PATCH fees.

routers/stripe_catalog.py: mixes `require_tournament(..., roles={super_admin, director})` with a follow-up `is_super_admin` check — the roles set effectively is only super_admin. Simplify to roles={'super_admin'}.
routers/shop.py voucher_lookup: uses code.strip().upper() but voucher_code stored is already uppercase; using scoped('purchases', tid) is correct — good.
frontend: The tournament home ShopStrip needed a hot-reload restart during testing (webpack HMR retained an older bundle after recent edits). Not a code bug, but noteworthy for QA setups.

pricing.sync_items writes lookup_key='fsl_dyn' for every synced kind — this overwrites existing lookup_key='fsl_custom' if a 'custom' product ever matched a PRICE_KEYS kind by accident. Currently 'custom' is not in PRICE_KEYS so safe.
